decisions.decision: AIAS is a professional digital-engineering platform, not merely CAD
The user is Project Director and domain approver; technical implementation must minimize programming burden on the user
AIAS owns its geometry, graphics and intelligent-object core; commercial applications are connectors
Standards are jurisdiction-aware independent packs, not formulas embedded in commands
No normative or construction claim without verified editions, licensed content and professional responsibility
Every major capability is specified, tested, documented, integrated and usable before closure
Architecture and engineering documentation evolve with code and preserve decision rationale
Value and professional time saved are primary progress measures
Internationalization, Unicode, locale and country profiles are designed into the core
Knowledge Center provides contextual, downloadable, country-aware and offline knowledge
AIAS University provides structured professional learning integrated with tools
Survey, terrain, coordinate, contour, profile and earthworks capabilities are first-class platform domains
All disciplines share attributable project and terrain models
AI is an engineering engine grounded in project data and authorized knowledge, not a generic chatbot
AIAS supports multidisciplinary building, infrastructure, MEP, healthcare and construction workflows
Important architectural choices require durable RFC/ADR/SDD-style records
Digital Twin and lifecycle data are architectural targets
Visual identity and consistent technical documentation are developed alongside the product
Country Knowledge Packs are independently installable and updateable
Historical schedules and version numbers are planning context, not binding delivery dates
